description: This file defines a ContentProvider named FeedProvider for an Android application. It manages access to a feed database, supporting operations such as query, insert, delete, and update for 'entries' stored in an SQLite database. The class includes URI matching logic to route requests appropriately, and contains an inner class for database creation and upgrade management.

classes.name: FeedProvider
classes.description: An Android ContentProvider that exposes feed entries stored in an SQLite database, allowing CRUD operations via URI routes.

classes.name: FeedProvider.FeedDatabase
classes.description: Inner class extending SQLiteOpenHelper that manages database creation and upgrades for the feed entries.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the database helper when the ContentProvider is created.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for data at the provided URI.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a query on the feed database based on the URI pattern.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new entry into the feed database.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes entries from the database based on URI and selection criteria.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates existing entries in the database for a given URI.

methods.name: FeedDatabase onCreate
methods.description: Creates the feed database with the specified schema.

methods.name: FeedDatabase onUpgrade
methods.description: Handles database schema upgrades by dropping and recreating tables.
